verdict.rationale: A Hacker News community comment states the core RDK is open source on GitHub (github.com/viamrobotics/rdk) while the cloud app itself is closed, which is corroborated by a GitHub reference. However, no first-party documentation confirms an explicit open-source license, and another commenter expresses uncertainty about how much of the codebase is genuinely open, indicating the openness story is only partially substantiated. missing for 10: explicit license file/name in first-party docs, clarity on which components (SDKs, modules, app) are covered vs proprietary, and confirmation the readable source is complete rather than partial.
